column1: # Ukrainian (uk) catalog. Same format as zh-hant.tsv: context <TAB> source <TAB> translation.
# Empty context = a plain UI string; @plural = one|few|many; @msg = a status/error template.
# Clean-room: translations of VectorCraft's labels, reviewed against their English meaning.
# The existing Russian catalog supplied the row layout and a machine-assisted draft, not any
# other product's localisation resources. Ukrainian vector-illustration terminology:
# монтажна область, шар, обведення, заливка, контур, опорна точка, зразки, пензель, виділення.
# Shortcut key names (Shift, Alt, Ctrl, Esc), command ids and placeholders remain unchanged.
# Coverage: every menu string, tl! literal, plural, status and error message (enforced in tests).
# Product, language, built-in workspace and perspective preset names follow MENU_KEEP_AS_IS.
# Keep placeholders, ellipses and leading/trailing spaces of fragments when editing.
